rationale: The stock has climbed from $183.91 to $204.76 on 4.09× relative volume after a strongly bullish earnings release that cited 78% revenue growth, margin expansion to 68%, and backlog up 166%. This mechanical combination of sustained buying flow, expansion away from the open, and immediate post-news absorption supports continuation while the bid-ask spread and proximity to the high keep risk defined below the 203.00–203.32 shelf.
